title: Impossible to clean
text:
Impossible to clean. Straight up folks, this is unsafe & a nightmare to clean. I used it to cube-chop white mushrooms & shallots. Pushing down with all my might, the male-grid nubs are too short to push the veggies all the way thru. I ended up having to gingerly remove the last unchopped layer of shallots & mushrooms from the blades, which are razor sharp. (I was so careful but I still ended up with a paper-cut slice in my finger) When I tried to wash it, veggie was jammed into the top plastic grid. I spent 3x as much time trying to clean this as I would have spent hand chopping. Also, so much food wasted.
I am not in the habit of leaving 1 star reviews, but I am leaving this honest review to help others make an informed decision. I feel like I wasted $30 & imo, this is too dangerous to store in a kitchen cabinet. This is going right into the trash.
